lines.en: I walk sideways through the shallows.

lines.zh: 六条腿划开水面，泛起细纹。
lines.en: Six legs cut the surface into fine ripples.
My shell slides along the sandy bottom.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧过来，避开石头。
lines.en: I edge sideways past a stone.
The water barely covers my shell.

lines.zh: 我拖着一条细长的尾剑。
lines.en: I trail a long thin tail-spike.

lines.zh: 我在沙上留下一道浅沟。
lines.en: I leave a shallow groove in the sand.

lines.zh: 我横着挪，避开一块碎壳。
lines.en: I edge sideways around a broken shell.

lines.zh: 我用腮盖下面的足拨水。
lines.en: I fan water with the legs under my gill covers.

lines.zh: 潮水退了一点，我跟着走。
lines.en: The tide pulls back and I follow.
I slip under a ledge.

lines.zh: 六条腿在湿沙上踩出小坑。
lines.en: Six legs leave little pits in the wet sand.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地挪到水深一点的地方。
lines.en: I shift slowly into deeper water.

lines.zh: 水底的贝壳硌得我不舒服。
lines.en: Shells on the bottom poke at me.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，把水从壳里排出去。
lines.en: I lift my head to drain the water from my shell.

lines.zh: 我沿着水线走，一路找吃的。
lines.en: I follow the waterline, foraging.
I settle in the sand with only my back showing.
Water runs over my shell.
I plant my tail-spike in the sand.
I watch the waterline creep up.
My gills work gently in the water.
A small crab crawls by; I ignore it.
A thin layer of sand coats my shell.

lines.zh: 我把眼睛抬起来看了看。
lines.en: I lift my eyes and look.
The warm water loosens my gills.
I press myself down into the wet sand.

lines.zh: 我把自己埋得只露眼睛。
lines.en: I bury myself until only my eyes show.
Water pushes sand over me.

lines.zh: 我的壳很硬，不容易被翻过来。
lines.en: My shell is hard to flip.
I wait for the water to rise.

lines.zh: 沙面一响，我把两只眼柄探出来。
lines.en: A sound on the sand and I poke both eyestalks up.

lines.zh: 你站在水里，脚边都是涟漪。
lines.en: You stand in the water, ripples at your feet.
I shift a little to the side.

lines.zh: 你的腿在水里像两根柱子。
lines.en: Your legs stand in the water like two pillars.

lines.zh: 我看了看你的脚，又看了看水。
lines.en: I look at your feet, then at the water.
You don't move; neither do I.
I raise my tail-spike.
Your shadow fills the water.
I'm not sure what you want.
I edge toward deeper water.
A thin split opens across my back plate.
The blow rolls me sideways.
My fluid is in the water.
My six legs flail.
I try to sink into the sand.
Even my tail-spike can't help.
Pain pins me.
I drag my tail spine and retreat deeper.
Even hard shells have seams.
Water seeps through my shell; I hold on.
There's a smell in the water.

lines.zh: 你撒下来的东西，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell what you scattered.
I sidle over.
I touch it with a claw first.
This is soft.
I pinch it up and bring it in.
Not even a mouthful.
I won't snatch. Slowly.
Step back so the water clears.
I stir up sand when I eat.
The bump slides me a distance.
Your boot heel knocks against my back.
I hurry to turn sideways.
The water goes murky.
I press against the reef and squeeze into the crack.
Your feet are heavy.
I nearly got pressed into the sand.
I flick my tail-spike.
Neither of us is hurt.
Watch the bottom when you walk.
A kin's scent in the tide.
We approach each other sideways.
Our shell rims touch.
We lay eggs in the wet sand.
The tide will carry them.
I cover the eggs with sand.
Then we part.
The water rises again.
Sand will hide the traces soon.
This beach is big enough.
I pinch it with a claw.
It slips loose and burrows back into the sand.
At last my claw tip catches the edge.
I press it into the sand.
It bites like hitting a pebble.
I pry the shell open with my hind legs.
The shell crunches.
I drag it into the water to eat.
I dropped it; I'll find it.
This scrap of meat belongs to my claws.
A second shadow joins the ripples.
I raise my tail-spike.
It's coming my way.
I turn broadside to face it.
My shell can take some of it.

lines.zh: 泥从水底腾起来，我伏低。
lines.en: Mud billows up from the bottom, so I flatten myself.
I back off first.
I can hide in the sand.
I count every stir in the water.
I retract my eyes.
A shadow presses down across my head shell.
I hold against the bottom.
Its shadow moves past.
I wait for it to move off.
The sand settles and the water clears again.
I rise slowly.
It hasn't come back.
I head deeper.
Safer here.
I let out a breath.
I jab with my tail-spike.
The jab lands by its foot.
I turn sideways and ram it with my shell edge.
My claw pinches its hide.
Once the jab lands, I sink into the sand.
I'm not strong.
I rely on shell and spike.
I drive my tail spine into the top of your foot.
I kick at the sand and right myself.
I burrow into the sand.
My back plate breaks through the sand surface.

lines.zh: 退潮留下的水洼里，我翻了个身。
lines.en: In a pool the tide left behind, I roll myself over.
The tide is right.
I walk a few steps sideways.
These shallows are quiet.
I stand my tail-spike up.
Water slides off my shell.
I find a ledge.
I settle beside it.
Wait for the water to rise.
The water heats and my shell burns.

lines.zh: 我摔在湿沙上，壳磕出声。
lines.en: I hit wet sand and my shell knocks loud.
Mud clogs my gills and I kick wildly.

lines.zh: 冲击把我从沙里掀出来。
lines.en: The blast tears me out of the sand.
An arrow ricochets and grazes me.
Light locks the water and I can't move.
Hunger makes even my shell feel light.

lines.zh: 电顺着水过来，我全身僵直。
lines.en: Current comes through the water; I go rigid.
The water's gone; I sink through black.
